versions.content: Service Name E2E_P76Check (draft) Syntax Std_ReturnType E2E_P76Check ( const E2E_P76ConfigType* ConfigPtr, E2E_P76CheckStateType* StatePtr, const uint8* DataPtr, uint32 Length ) Service ID [hex] 0x84 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant ConfigPtr Pointer to static configuration. DataPtr Pointer to received data. Parameters (in) Length Length of the data in bytes. Parameters (inout) StatePtr Pointer to received data. Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E2E_E_INPUTERR_NULL E2E_E_INPUTERR_WRONG E2E_E_INTERR E2E_E_OK For definitions for return values, see SWS_E2E_00047. Description Checks the Data received using the E2E profile 76. This includes CRC calculation, handling of Counter. The function checks only one single data in one cycle, it does not determine/compute the accumulated state of the communication link. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via E2E.h
